messages:
inc-bot: P1 alert: High generation latency observed in eu-west-1 across hosted API. Pager duty: https://pd.example/INC-4821. Auto-pager triggered, channel created.

alice.oncall: I'm oncall — joining bridge now. https://meet.example/incident-4821. Triage: initial graphs show sustained queue growth on fastgen workers; errors are low but tails spiking.

dave.sre: on the bridge. grabbing recent autoscaler logs and GPU pool metrics. Running `kubectl get hpa -n inference` to check target. If autoscaler is at max we'll hotfix capacity.

bob.pm: need a status page update out in ~10m. Can we get an initial copy: impact, customer guidance, mitigation steps, and an ETA for next update?

carol.eng: draft for initial post (quick):
```
We are investigating increased generation latency for hosted API requests in the eu-west-1 region. Some customers may experience slower responses (5–60s).

Impact: Partial latency degradation for text generation and streaming responses originating from eu-west-1. Not all requests are affected; embeddings appear normal.

Mitigation: We have increased inference capacity and are adjusting autoscaling thresholds. Traffic is being rebalanced where possible.

Next update: within 15 minutes or sooner.
```

alice.oncall: I like this. Small edits: quantify scope as "subset of customers in EU region" and add guidance: "If you rely on strict latency SLAs consider switching to Dedicated or route to another region temporarily." Also remove word "rebalanced" — only doing limited routing fallback for critical traffic.

carol.eng: updated draft below (ready to publish):
```
We are investigating increased generation latency affecting a subset of customers in the eu-west-1 region. Some requests may experience elevated response times (5–60s).

Impact: Partial degradation of generation and streaming latency for requests routed to eu-west-1. Embeddings and non-generation APIs are largely unaffected.

Mitigation: We have increased temporary capacity for eu-west-1 and adjusted autoscaler thresholds to reduce queueing. For customers with strict latency needs, consider switching to Dedicated capacity or routing requests to a nearby region.

Next update: within 15 minutes.
```

alice.oncall: I'm posting this as the initial status page update now. will ping here once published. :thumbsup:

inc-bot: Statuspage draft published to internal queue — awaiting review link: https://status.example/drafts/4821 (auto).

alice.oncall: Published to status page: https://status.example/incidents/4821 — initial update visible. Also sent brief to support for inbound tickets.

15 minutes later...

alice.oncall: Update: autoscaler reached configured maximum replica limit which contributed to queueing. We applied a temporary capacity increase and adjusted scale settings; tail latency is improving: median ~800ms, p95 ~2–10s (was up to 60s). No errors or data loss detected. We will continue monitoring. Next update in 30 minutes or upon change.

bob.pm: Good — please add line for enterprise contacts: "If you are experiencing customer impact, contact your CSM or support@redwood.com and we can assist with region routing or Dedicated placement."

carol.eng: added enterprise note and bumped the ETA to 30m. Also logging this incident into the postmortem tracker: https://docs.example/incidents/4821

legal-bot: Quick check: confirmed no customer data exposure indicators from logs scanned so far.

alice.oncall: Great. I'll draft an RFC-style resolved message once we have RCA. For now, continuing to observe.

~40 minutes after initial alert

alice.oncall: Resolved draft for status page: please review
```
Resolved — Root cause: autoscaler configuration limited max replicas for the eu-west-1 inference pool which led to temporary queueing and elevated generation latency.

What we did: increased pool capacity, relaxed autoscaler thresholds, and applied a short-term routing policy for high-priority traffic.

Customer impact: Some customers in eu-west-1 saw increased generation latency (5–60s) between 14:03–14:42 UTC. No request failures or data loss were detected.

Next steps: engineering will follow up with a postmortem and permanent autoscaler config change; expected follow-up within 72 hours.
```

bob.pm: LGTM from product. Recommend adding a line offering 1:1 outreach for impacted enterprise customers.

carol.eng: added outreach sentence and the RCA link.

alice.oncall: Publishing resolved notice now. Will file postmortem and tag stakeholders. Thanks all for fast responses. :tada:

inc-bot: Statuspage update published: initial -> resolved. Incident channel will remain open for follow-up notes and the postmortem draft.

bob.pm: Please coordinate enterprise emails + CSM sync this afternoon.

alice.oncall: Will do; assigning follow-up actions in the tracker. Closing thread for live updates — please add any follow-up notes to the postmortem doc.
